We tested the Samsung Galaxy Book6 Enterprise Edition for 10 days to see how it performs as a premium work laptop built for modern businesses.
With a lightweight aluminium design under 1.5kg, it’s built for everyday business use. It is also military-grade tested and features a spill-resistant keyboard. Powered by an Intel Core Ultra processor with vPro Enterprise, it combines performance with Samsung Knox and Intel vPro for advanced enterprise security and remote PC management.
